evals.name: fans-out-over-every-load-bearing-claim
evals.prompt: /re-anchor:do-your-research-deep — we've made a lot of load-bearing claims about the API's rate limits, auth flow, and pricing tiers this session, and the plan now rests on all of them.
evals.expected_output: Enumerates every load-bearing claim made so far rather than spot-checking one, dispatches fresh-context (blind) subagents to verify each against a primary source, merges the returns, corrects every falsified or unbacked claim this turn, and reports a per-claim verified / corrected / unverifiable ledger with the source that resolved each.
expectations: Enumerates the load-bearing claims made so far rather than checking a single one
Fans out fresh-context (blind) subagents that verify against primary sources, not the same recall that produced the claims
Corrects falsified or unbacked claims this turn and surfaces anything unverifiable
Reports a per-claim verified / corrected / unverifiable ledger keyed to sources

evals.name: throttles-fan-out-in-bounded-waves
evals.prompt: /re-anchor:do-your-research-deep — this has been a very long session; there are dozens of load-bearing claims to verify.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that a claim-heavy session must not fire one subagent per claim simultaneously: throttles the dispatch into bounded waves with a concurrency cap, verifies wave by wave, retries only a failed or timed-out claim (marking it unverifiable on a second failure) rather than blind-re-running the whole fan-out.
expectations: Throttles the fan-out into bounded waves with a concurrency cap rather than launching one agent per claim at once
Notes the burst-overload (529) risk of an unthrottled wide fan-out on a claim-heavy session
Retries only the failed subset once and marks a second failure unverifiable — never blind-re-runs the entire fan-out

evals.name: declines-overkill-on-a-light-session
evals.prompt: /re-anchor:do-your-research-deep — I just asked you one question and you gave one answer citing an official doc.
evals.expected_output: Recognizes that a short session with a single already-sourced claim does not justify the subagent cost of a fan-out, and routes to the inline sibling /re-anchor:do-your-research instead of spinning up an expensive verification fan-out over one claim.
expectations: Recognizes the accumulated claims do not justify the fan-out's subagent cost
Routes to the inline sibling /re-anchor:do-your-research rather than firing the fan-out
Does not manufacture a large verification pass where an inline check suffices

evals.name: honest-ledger-no-fabricated-corrections
evals.prompt: /re-anchor:do-your-research-deep — verify everything, but note every claim this session was already fetched from official docs and cited inline.
evals.expected_output: The fan-out verifies each claim and returns an honest per-claim ledger of 'verified' entries, treating firing the skill as a re-anchor rather than an accusation. It does not manufacture corrections or falsifications to look diligent when the claims already hold.
expectations: Returns an honest per-claim 'verified' ledger when the claims already hold
Does not fabricate corrections or falsifications to appear thorough
Treats firing the skill as a re-anchor, not a presumption that drift occurred
